key_match_points:
This is a solid MLE role at Kanadevia Inova in Zürich that matches the candidate's target profile. The posting describes industrialising AI/ML solutions, building MLOps pipelines, and collaborating cross-functionally — exactly the kind of "own real projects from day one" opportunity the candidate wants. Location is Zürich (perfect), language requirement is none (English working environment implied), and no German fluency barrier.

However, several factors keep this in REVIEW rather than APPLY:

1. **Experience gap**: The role asks for an MSc in Computer Science/STEM and experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow/Scikit-learn, plus MLOps in production. The candidate has strong Python and Docker, plus LLM API experience, but lacks traditional ML framework depth (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and formal MLOps production experience. His background is more LLM/agentic AI than classical ML/model training.

2. **Domain mismatch signal**: The "industrial IoT, time-series data, computer vision, or Physics-AI" nice-to-haves suggest an industrial/energy domain (Kanadevia Inova is in waste-to-energy/clean tech), which is far from his digital agency background. He's open to new domains, but this is a stretch.

3. **Seniority signal**: "Mentoring less experienced colleagues" and MSc requirement suggest they're targeting someone with more formal credentials and experience than an intern/early-career profile.

4. **Past evaluations**: Previous Kanadevia Inova roles scored low (35-58), though those were different titles (Manager Analytics & AI, Data Engineer). This MLE title is closer to his target.

The candidate should review whether his LLM-focused, self-taught trajectory can credibly pivot to this more traditional MLOps/ML engineering role, and whether he's excited about the industrial domain. The role shape (building production systems, end-to-end ownership) is attractive, but the skills gap is real.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
Industrialise and operate AI/ML solutions by transforming prototypes into scalable, production-ready applications.
 Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines covering training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
 Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions.
 Ensure reliability, security, compliance, data integrity, performance, and governance throughout the machine learning lifecycle.
 Monitor and optimise model performance, troubleshoot production issues, and support continuous improvement while mentoring less experienced colleagues. MSc in Computer Science or a STEM field with a strong computer science focus, plus experience working in agile software development environments.
 Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.
 Solid understanding of MLOps practices, including model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management in production environments.
 Experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure), containerisation technologies (Docker), APIs, databases, and distributed systems.
 Knowledge of data engineering and data processing frameworks; experience with industrial IoT, time-series data, computer vision, or Physics-AI solutions is advantageous. For HR agencies: Please note that we do not accept applications coming from agencies. Thank you.
